tasks.short: Estimate appliance repair costs and recommend repair or replacement.

steps.what: Check actual appliance fault findings, model, age and customer requirements
inputs: actual appliance diagnostic findings
actual customer requirements
outputs: checked appliance estimate requirements and repair scope

steps.what: Calculate repair cost options using native parts catalogue and labour estimate fields
inputs: checked appliance estimate requirements and repair scope
actual current parts prices, compatibility and labour rates
outputs: repairer-checked priced repair options

steps.what: Judge whether actual repair or replacement better fits the appliance and customer
inputs: repairer-checked priced repair options
actual replacement options and customer constraints
outputs: human repair or replacement recommendation and caveats

steps.what: Write and approve the complete final repair estimate and recommendation for the customer
inputs: human repair or replacement recommendation and caveats
repairer-checked priced repair options
outputs: approved final customer estimate and recommendation with exact recipient

steps.what: Deliver the approved final cost estimate and recommendation to the approved customer
inputs: approved final customer estimate and recommendation with exact recipient
outputs: delivered final appliance estimate

tasks.design: Configure exact parts and labour estimate fields in {FIELD_SERVICE_SYSTEM}, denoted OTHER with {PROCUREMENT} catalogue data. The repairer checks compatibility and costs, makes the repair-versus-replacement judgement and writes the complete final estimate. Its approval precedes the separate customer delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Parts and labour lines may still be manually copied and totalled for each estimate.
tasks.enabler_now: Native estimating fields can reuse actual compatible parts and current rates.
tasks.still_hard: Reliability, uncertain additional faults and the customer actual constraints.
tasks.human_edge: The repairer explains a practical recommendation rather than treating price as the whole decision.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated estimate arithmetic with human recommendations retained.

evidence.claim: Field service systems support quote-to-invoice work; exact estimate configuration remains proposed.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Verify residual manual estimate transcription and arithmetic after existing quoting functions. Existing quote totals and runtime earn no benefit.

s1 captures actual model_id, fault, chosen repair scope and estimated labour quantity at full time. Actual catalogue and rate owners supply part_id, compatibility, price and hourly_rate. s2 retains 10 hours for current-price, compatibility and quantity checks; missing fields use manual estimating.
s3 retains full recommendation judgement. s4 approves complete final text, price, caveats and recipient; changed content or recipient requires renewed approval before delivery.
research_questions: Which estimate lines still require manual copying after current quoting settings?

incremental.description: Maintain actual parts and labour estimate field mappings

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final priced estimate, recommendation and exact customer

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only estimate preparation changes: 25 times 60% = 15 less 1 upkeep = 14. Low halves that benefit: 7.5 less 1 = 6.5.

tasks.short: Record actual maintenance and repair work performed on appliances.

steps.what: Capture actual appliance work, parts, readings and unresolved issues from the completed repair
inputs: actual completed appliance maintenance and repair observations
outputs: repairer-captured actual work fields and free-text repair note

steps.what: Populate exact maintenance record fields using native work-order templates
inputs: repairer-captured actual work fields and free-text repair note
actual asset and work-order identifiers
outputs: candidate exact appliance repair record fields

steps.what: Draft and substantively check the maintenance narrative against actual repair notes
inputs: repairer-captured actual work fields and free-text repair note
candidate exact appliance repair record fields
outputs: repairer-checked complete candidate appliance repair narrative

loop.purpose: Express variable actual repair notes as a clear maintenance narrative
loop.input: Actual repairer note and exact candidate fields only
loop.output: Candidate narrative preserving actual work, readings, limitations and unresolved faults
loop.check: Repairer checks every action, cause, reading and qualification against actual notes, including omissions and any false implication of successful repair
loop.stop: Missing evidence or two failed corrections returns to manual narrative writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native fields handle fixed values first; variable explanation of actual fault and repair sequence requires prose checking

steps.what: Check and approve the complete final actual appliance maintenance record
inputs: candidate exact appliance repair record fields
repairer-checked complete candidate appliance repair narrative
outputs: approved final actual appliance maintenance record

steps.what: Commit the approved final appliance maintenance record
inputs: approved final actual appliance maintenance record
outputs: saved actual appliance maintenance record

tasks.design: Configure exact work-order fields in {FIELD_SERVICE_SYSTEM}, denoted OTHER, from the repairer actual captured work. Use a bounded prose loop only for variable narrative after native fields; the repairer checks all meaning and approves the complete final record before its separate commit. No work or successful repair is inferred from a planned job.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual repair observations may be recopied into repeated fields and a separate narrative.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates reuse exact fields; bounded drafting can reword actual repair notes.
tasks.still_hard: Accurately distinguishing an observation, diagnosis, action and unresolved issue.
tasks.human_edge: The repairer knows what was actually done and what remains unsafe or uncertain.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated record composition after actual appliance repair.

evidence.claim: Maintenance tools support work-order voice notes and reviewed drafting; this actual-note narrative design is proposed.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Verify residual manual re-entry and narrative composition after existing mobile work-order features; existing transcription, auto-filled fields and runtime earn no new benefit.

s1 retains 25 hours to capture actual asset_id, work_order_id, work_date, performed_actions, used_parts, actual_readings and unresolved_issues plus narrative explanation. Existing asset records supply identifiers. Missing actual content is captured manually before drafting, never invented.
s3 retains 18 hours for full narrative meaning checks and correction; s4 retains full final combined review. Any later change voids approval. Same-system commit earns no benefit.
research_questions: Which fields and prose are still manually repeated after current mobile work-order capture?

incremental.description: Maintain actual-work field mappings and audit narrative source fidelity

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final actual appliance maintenance record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross = 25 exact-field re-entry plus 30 times 40% narrative = 37; less 2 upkeep = 35. Low changes only half of field re-entry and leaves narrative manual: 12.5 less 2 = 10.5.
